about: The pixel scene in depth layers, back to front, each the full 320×180 at 1× on transparent. Stacked in this order they make scene-320x180.png. depth: 0 is the sky (still), 1 the nearest; move nearer layers more.

layers.name: sky
layers.holds: The night sky's stepped bands, the moon's halo and the stars. Opaque.

layers.name: clouds-far
layers.holds: The far cloud bank on the horizon.

layers.name: islands-far
layers.holds: Netherite, diamond and the KOTH island, hazed by distance.

layers.name: clouds-mid
layers.holds: The low bank of cloud under the route's middle.

layers.name: island-gold
layers.holds: The gold island and its glowing mine.

layers.name: island-hub
layers.holds: The hub: cabin, lanterns, lights and chimney smoke.

layers.name: clouds-near
layers.holds: The near sea of cloud over the islands' tips.
